title: Supplement to 'Sharp bounds on the Eliashberg critical temperature': Lean formalization, computer-assisted certificates and scripts
description:
Supplementary material for D. Rens, "Sharp bounds on the Eliashberg critical temperature: a comparison principle, convexity in the spectrum, and the Kiessling–Altshuler–Yuzbashyan conjectures".

Contents: a Lean 4 formalization (Mathlib v4.35.0) of the finite-dimensional core of the proofs (16 theorems, axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound only); a primary computer-assisted proof of the Einstein inequality in Arb ball arithmetic and an independent exact-rational certificate, with their receipts; and the scripts that write the certificate numbers quoted in the paper, the figure data and the floating-point checks. Floating-point values marked as such in the paper are not certified.
